subject: RemitCare - Handoff & kickoff plan
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@remitcare.com>
Date: 2028-06-14T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: RemitCare - final pricing and handoff

Team — quick summary after legal sign: RemitCare (RDW-5247) executed the order on 6/13. Upfront details: 6 x A100 reserved for Dedicated for the 12-month pilot; monthly commit starts July 1. They requested a June 20-22 pilot kickoff window to shadow initial integration work.

Attached: remitcare-sow-draft.pdf (SOW draft, includes pilot scope + acceptance criteria). I’ve copied Alicia so she has the SOW.

Open items for handoff: 
- Confirm CS owner and implementation lead
- Validate SSO / IdP day-1 checklist (they flagged Okta)
- Security questionnaire items (I’ve attached a starting spreadsheet)
- Decide on a short-term rollback policy for the pilot (we suggested auto-fallback to smaller model variant)

Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachment: remitcare-sow-draft.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)
Attachment: remitcare-security-answers.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Liu <evan.liu@remitcare.com>
Date: 2028-06-14T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RemitCare - final pricing and handoff

Thanks Ben — and congrats team. I’ll take overall ownership of the account post-sign (monica_patel as mailbox owner for this thread). Below are immediate assignments and proposed timeline so CS/implementation can mobilize quickly: 

Owners and roles (internal):
- Monica Patel — Account Lead (primary exec contact, escalations, billing checkpoints)
- Tessa Morgan — Implementation Lead (owns kickoff agenda, sprint 0, runbook)
- Karthik Iyer — Integration/Platform Escalation (model/throughput sizing, Dedicated pool config)
- Ben Carter — Sales SME (first-week handover/check-ins + pricing clarifications)

Immediate next actions (by EOD 6/15):
1) Tessa/Triage: confirm availability for a 60-minute kickoff on June 20 at 10am PT. Please propose alternate slots if not possible.
2) Karthik: review the SOW pilot acceptance criteria and add any platform preflight items to the attached spreadsheet (SSO endpoints, allowed IPs, data retention).
3) Monica: I will send the kickoff invite, HubSpot link and a short pre-kickoff checklist to Alicia and Evan today.
4) Ben: please flag any commercial edge cases (discounts, seats, trial overage) we need to track.

Risk notes: pilot depends on Okta metadata exchange (RemitCare says they’ll provide metadata by 6/18). If that slips, we’ll push the kickoff by one week. Also note they asked for reduced telemetry retention for pilot logs — will need SOC2/compliance signoff before changing defaults.

Tessa — I’m including a short template for the kickoff agenda in the Drive link. Keep the first sprint focused: integration + simple inference loop + acceptance test 1 (latency < 200ms p50 w/ 512 tokens).

Monica Patel | Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Cell: (415) 555-0104
Redwood Inference
Related: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deal/RDW-5247
Attachment: remitcare-sow-draft.pdf (referenced)

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@remitcare.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-14T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RemitCare - final pricing and handoff

Thanks Monica — appreciate the clear owners. June 20 at 10am PT works for our team (Evan and I will join). A few items for the kickoff agenda from our side: 

- Okta metadata: we’ll send by EOD 6/17 (confirming plan)
- SSO user mapping: we want a sample attribute map (email, employeeId, role) — can we get that in advance?
- Data retention / logs: pilot should have 30-day logs but we may request masking for PHI-derived fields (we will share an internal policy doc)
- Pilot scope: for the first 2 weeks we’ll test 2 endpoints: chat API and embeddings. We expect ~2000 requests/day during pilot peak — please confirm Dedicated sizing.

We’ve reviewed the SOW and left two small edits: clarify clause on intellectual property of prompt templates (we need the language tightened). I’ll put the edits in DocuSign or directly in the attached SOW and return.

Looking forward to kickoff.

— Alicia
Alicia Gomez | Head of ML Integrations, RemitCare
Alicia.Gomez@remitcare.com
Attachment: remitcare-sow-draft.pdf (minor redlines expected)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-14T15:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RemitCare - final pricing and handoff

Perfect — Alicia confirms 6/20 10am PT. I’ve booked the slot and will send the calendar with a short pre-kick checklist to Alicia/Evan and the implementation owners. Quick internal checklist before invite: 

- Triage: Tessa to circulate Sprint 0 template + test accounts by 6/18
- Platform: Karthik to validate Dedicated pool sizing for 2k req/day peak and provide an ops-runbook snippet for failure modes
- Legal/Docs: Ben to review Alicia’s redline on IP clause and escalate to legal if needed
- Security: I’ll flag the data-retention ask to our compliance team and request SOC2 excerpt for external-facing note

If any of you can’t make the kickoff, note an alternate owner in the calendar so we have coverage. I’ll post the final agenda to the Drive link and paste the hubspot record in the invite.

Thanks — see you on the 20th.

Monica
Monica Patel | Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Related link: https://drive.redwood.com/remitcare/implementation-playbook
